```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
snap_urls <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)
snap_years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)

scrape_snapshot <- function(url, snap_year) {
  page <- request(url) |>
    req_timeout(60) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3, backoff = ~ 5) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_html()

  tbl <- page |>
    html_element("table") |>
    html_table()

  attr_vals <- page |>
    html_elements("td strong") |>
    html_attr("title")

  tbl |>
    select(rank_title_year = `Rank & Title`, rating = `IMDb Rating`) |>
    mutate(
      rank_title_year = str_replace_all(rank_title_year, "\n +", " "),
      number = str_extract(attr_vals, "(?<=based on )[0-9,]+") |>
        parse_number()
    ) |>
    separate_wider_regex(
      rank_title_year,
      patterns = c(
        rank = "\\d+",
        "\\. ",
        title = ".+",
        " +\\(",
        year = "\\d+",
        "\\)"
      )
    ) |>
    mutate(
      rank = as.integer(rank),
      year = as.integer(year),
      snap_year = snap_year
    ) |>
    select(snap_year, rank, title, year, rating, number)
}

imdb_snapshots <- map2(snap_urls, snap_years, scrape_snapshot) |>
  list_rbind()
```

```{r}
rank_changes <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year == 2015) |>
  select(title, year, rank_2015 = rank) |>
  inner_join(
    imdb_snapshots |>
      filter(snap_year == 2022) |>
      select(title, rank_2022 = rank),
    by = "title"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    release_decade = year %/% 10 * 10,
    rank_change = rank_2022 - rank_2015
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(abs(rank_change))) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

print(rank_changes)
print(
  rank_changes |>
    group_by(release_decade) |>
    summarize(avg_rank_change = mean(rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
    arrange(release_decade)
)
```

```{r}
film_snapshot_counts <- imdb_snapshots |>
  distinct(title, snap_year) |>
  count(title, name = "snapshot_count")

print(
  film_snapshot_counts |>
    count(snapshot_count, name = "films") |>
    arrange(snapshot_count)
)
```

```{r}
decade_rank_changes <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year == 2015) |>
  select(title, year, rank_2015 = rank) |>
  inner_join(
    imdb_snapshots |>
      filter(snap_year == 2022) |>
      select(title, rank_2022 = rank),
    by = "title"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    release_decade = year %/% 10 * 10,
    rank_change = rank_2022 - rank_2015
  ) |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarize(avg_rank_change = mean(rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    direction = if_else(
      avg_rank_change < 0,
      "Rank rose (moved up)",
      "Rank fell (moved down)"
    ),
    release_decade = factor(
      release_decade,
      levels = sort(unique(release_decade))
    )
  )

ggplot(
  decade_rank_changes,
  aes(x = avg_rank_change, y = release_decade, fill = direction)
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = \(decade) paste0(decade, "s")) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Rank rose (moved up)" = "#0072B2",
      "Rank fell (moved down)" = "#D55E00"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "IMDb Top 250 Rank Changes by Release Decade",
    subtitle = "Rank change is 2022 rank minus 2015 rank; negative values moved up the chart.",
    x = "Average rank change (2022 rank - 2015 rank)",
    y = "Film release decade",
    fill = "Average rank direction",
    caption = "Sample size: 190 films appearing in both the 2015 and 2022 snapshots."
  )
```
